subject: general
question: Ananya, Anita, Priya and Madhu are dining around a square table facing the centre. Each friend is sitting at the middle of one of the four sides. Madhu is sitting to the left of Anita. Priya is sitting to the right of Ananya. Who is sitting to the left of Madhu?
solution:
Given:

Ananya, Anita, Priya and Madhu are dining around a square table facing the centre. Each friend is sitting at the middle of one of the four sides.

1) Madhu is sitting to the left of Anita.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f186f5e50fcd7a3279464828bb3039e7ca973941944c23804a4881daf770994e.png] 

2) Priya sitting to the right of Ananya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dea015e98c68d66f254b2fc34eb706ea53f36c1dc46482b39294e0318ad3c19.png] 

Hence, **"Priya" **is sitting to the left of Madhu.
